name: Torneo AI Language
description: Provides shared AI language policy and integration for Torneoz sites.
project_description:
Provides a shared, provider-neutral language policy for Drupal AI and Torneo integrations.

 Features 
 
 Installs a curated set of Drupal languages on first enable. 
 Exposes active source and target language context to AI consumers. 
 Provides normalized language codes, names, text directions, and optional prompt instructions. 
 Lets Torneo, AI Image Studio, Grok, and other integrations share one language policy. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Configure the language policy at /admin/config/services/torneo-ai-language . AI integrations can inject the torneo_ai_language.language_policy service.

 Additional Requirements 
 Requires Drupal 11.3 or later and Drupal AI 1.4 or later.

 Similar projects 
 Translation modules translate content. Torneo AI Language instead provides a shared language-context and prompting policy for multiple AI integrations.
